description: This file contains unit tests for the IdClashAttributeAnalyzer, which detects duplicate [Id] attributes in serializable types in Orleans serialization. It uses Xunit for testing and verifies that the analyzer correctly identifies duplicate IDs in classes, structs, records, and record structs marked with [GenerateSerializer], while ignoring types without this attribute.

classes.name: IdClashAttributeAnalyzerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the IdClashAttributeAnalyzer, testing detection of duplicate [Id] attributes in Orleans serializable types.

methods.name: VerifyHasDiagnostic
methods.description: Asserts that the provided code triggers the expected number of diagnostics from the analyzer.

methods.name: VerifyHasNoDiagnostic
methods.description: Asserts that the provided code does not trigger any diagnostics from the analyzer.

methods.name: TypesWithGenerateSerializerAndDuplicatedIds_ShouldTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Test case verifying that duplicate [Id] attributes in [GenerateSerializer] types trigger diagnostics.

methods.name: TypesWithGenerateSerializerAndNoDuplicatedIds_ShouldNoTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Test case verifying that unique [Id] attributes in [GenerateSerializer] types do not trigger diagnostics.

methods.name: TypesWithoutGenerateSerializerAndDuplicatedIds_ShouldNotTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Test case verifying that duplicate [Id] attributes in types without [GenerateSerializer] do not trigger diagnostics.
